r4_call.note: thinner tails price cheaper; no arbiter exists (descriptive only)

verdict_text: Structure learner YES (4/4 inside the data's sampling envelope, decisively above the Gaussian floor, zero memorized blocks). Dispersion FAIL: panel variance ratio 0.45, kurtosis 9.9 vs real 22.6 — the same under-dispersion signature the synthetic gate showed, so it is the objective+critic's, not the teacher's. And the free comparator beats the point: historical block-resampling matches the real estimators as well or better on every row at this sample size — the GAN buys nothing the bootstrap doesn't already give on 2y of data. The BofA regime's promise survives only where data is LONGER than the events you're sampling.
